subject: reasoning
question: Hitesh starts from Point A and drives 9 km towards East. He then takes a left turn, drives 4 km, turns left and drives 11 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 6 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 2 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given:

 
• Hitesh starts from Point A and drives 9 km towards East.
 
• He then takes a left turn, drives 4 km, turns left and drives 11 km.
 
• He then takes a left turn and drives 6 km.
 
• He takes a final left turn, drives 2 km and stops at Point P.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/469047429a676623e1bb9a23f94df7f1f9f96c534307ee983bd82524e8f6a83f.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
